title: Delegated Service-Account Template Enforcer and Ownership Lifecycle (RBAC v2 ready)
creator: Asha Menon
description: Background: Service accounts are frequently created ad-hoc by teams which leads to inconsistent permissions, unclear ownership, and poor audit signal. With RBAC v2 and expanded SSO/SAML onboarding flows, we need a controlled, auditable path for creating service accounts that enforces least-privilege templates and captures ownership metadata for lifecycle automation. Goal: ship a delegated provisioning flow (console + CLI wizard + API) that validates against a canonical template catalog, attaches owner and rotation TTL metadata, emits enriched audit events, and integrates with SSO group mappings. This ticket covers the template enforcement engine, ownership assignment UI/UX, audit enrichment hooks, and migration guardrails for existing orphaned accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Admins and designated delegates can create service accounts through the Console wizard and CLI that only allow permissions from the approved template catalog.
Every created SA has an owner field (user or group), a TTL for automated rotation or expiration, and a human-readable purpose string attached.
Provisioning emits structured audit events (actor, reason, template_id, owner, requested_permissions, grant_hash) to the central audit pipeline with searchable fields.
Template validation rejects wide-scoped grants (e.g., wildcard resource=*) unless explicitly approved via an escalation workflow.
Existing service accounts without owners are surfaced in a staging dashboard and can be bulk-assigned or scheduled for deprecation with clear notifications.
E2E tests for console, CLI, and API flows are added and included in the security regression suite.
Rollout plan defined: pilot with 3 internal teams, canary to 10% of orgs, fallback path documented.
Security review completed and sign-off obtained before GA.
Telemetry: percent of SAs created from templates, number of orphaned SAs, average time-to-owner, and audit event volume are tracked in Console dashboards.
RBAC v2 compatibility: templates map to v2 role descriptors and do not require runtime role mutation during request handling.

migration_plan: Phase 0 (staging): Run discovery script across staging orgs to identify SAs without owner or TTL. Generate CSV and surface in staging dashboard.
Phase 1 (pilot): Enable template-only provisioning for a pilot org, require owner assignment at creation, and run migration for pilot org to auto-suggest owners.
Phase 2 (canary): Enable for 10% of orgs with soft enforcement (warnings + audit). Monitor orphan count and support tickets for 2 weeks.
Phase 3 (enforce): Hard-enforce template validation and owner-required field for all new SAs; begin scheduled deprecation emails for identified orphans older than 90 days.
Bulk remediation: allow admins to bulk-assign owner groups from CSV with audit trail and optional expiration policy tag.
Rollback: feature flag to disable template enforcement and revert to previous provisioning path for emergency recovery.
implementation_decisions: Use a central Template Service (read-only at runtime) that stores canonical templates and validation rules. The Template Service is versioned and immutable per template_id+version.
Do not create runtime roles dynamically during request-handling. Templates map to RBAC v2 role descriptors emitted at provisioning time and token-scoped checks will use those descriptors.
Audit events will include a grant_hash computed from normalized template + owner + TTL, stored immutably for future drift detection.
Owner can be a user or group; group ownership will be resolved via SSO group mappings for SAML/SCIM-enabled orgs.
Rotation/TTL is advisory for Hosted customers and enforced (expiration) for Dedicated/Private with optional auto-rotate webhook.
Escalation path: templates marked escalation_required=true will trigger an approval workflow with email + console approval, recorded in audit logs.
testing_plan: Unit tests for template validator (resource patterns, action whitelist/blacklist, escalation flag).
Integration test: console wizard -> API -> template service -> audit pipeline. Use mocked SSO group mappings for owner resolution.
E2E regression suite: ensure existing token issuance flows for pre-v2 SAs not broken by enforcement feature flag.
Chaos test: simulate Template Service downtime and verify fallback behavior (read cached policy, log degraded mode).
Load test: create 5k SAs via CLI script in staging to validate audit event throughput and template cache performance.
